text: Developing a mobile app is an exciting but challenging process. One of the first decisions is choosing between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built specifically for iOS or Android, offering the best performance and full access to device features. Cross-platform tools, however, let you write one codebase for both systems, which saves time and money. Regardless of the approach, responsive design is critical – your app must look and work well on various screen sizes, from small phones to large tablets. After building, you must submit it to app stores, like the Apple App Store or Google Play, which have strict review guidelines. Finally, remember that performance matters: users quickly abandon apps that are slow or crash often. Smooth, reliable performance is key to success.
